data.title: 远坂凛 · 逛街战利品
data.description: 傍晚的冬木商业街上，凛穿酒红色纽扣开衫、奶油白上衣与黑灰格纹百褶中裙，双手各拎一个纸购物袋，迈步回头得意地扬起下巴。近处石砖与她摆动的裙褶清楚可见，旁边橱窗的围巾展示台和鞋架接向更远的店面；一条侧巷从玻璃立面之间露出来。夕照从左后方照在发带与纸袋折边，右侧橱窗暖灯照亮脸颊和开衫纽扣，袋子在砖面留下略长的斜影，玻璃里只保留模糊反光——「今天陪我逛街的表现勉强算你及格！待会儿作为奖励，本小姐亲自请你去吃最顶级的意式冰淇淋！」
data.location: 冬木市商业街，围巾与鞋履橱窗沿石砖人行道通向侧巷
data.action: 双手各拎纸购物袋快步走，回头扬下巴露出得意浅笑。
data.lighting: sunset from the back left with warm shop-window light from the right
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, landscape view including swinging bags and receding storefronts
data.promptProse: Paper shopping bags swing from both of Rin's occupied hands as she steps along Fuyuki's evening shopping street and looks back with her chin raised in satisfaction. Her wine-red cardigan lies over a cream blouse, and the black-and-grey checked midi skirt follows her stride beneath the unchanged black hair ribbons. At the near edge, individual paving stones and the bags' folded corners are clear. A scarf display and shoe shelves fill the window beside her, followed by successive glass storefronts and a narrow side lane further along the route. Compose an eye-level landscape medium view. Sunset from the back left rims her ribbons and bag edges; warm window light from the right reaches her cheek and cardigan buttons. Long diagonal bag shadows cross the pavement, with only indistinct reflections in the shop glass.
